Hello, thank you for visiting my page.

I am an academic biostatistician and health researcher with a strong background in health research methods, biostatistics, and data science. I have extensive experience, expertise, and skills in designing and conducting health research studies.

I am involved in both methodological and epidemiological research. My research areas include clinical trials, real-world evidence, causal inference, omics, systematic review and meta-analysis, data science, machine learning, aging and bone health. I am also interested in collaborative research.

I work as an Assistant Professor in the Department of Health Research Methods, Evidence, and Impact (HEI) at McMaster University and as a methodologist/biostatistician at the Research Institute of St Joseph's Healthcare Hamilton, Ontario, Canada.
